settings.label: Sale ends
settings.info: Actual sale deadline in ISO format, e.g. 2026-11-30T23:59:00+08:00. Leave empty to hide the countdown.

settings.label: Stands left at sale price
settings.info: Set only to a verified current sale allocation. Zero hides the stock message. This is not synced to inventory.

settings.label: Order by email
settings.info: Set this to take orders by email instead of the Shopify cart (used by the static tap4.ph site). Leave empty on Shopify.

settings.label: Menu upload endpoint
settings.info: Where checkout uploads menu files (PDF/JPG/PNG), e.g. https://go.tap4.ph/upload/menu. Empty hides the upload box.
